mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, need_number, need_date, parts_number, parts_name FROM tb_purchase_parts_order_detail WHERE id = #{detailId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM tb_srm_po_split_line WHERE detail_id = #{detailId} AND shipped_qty > 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_srm_po_split_line WHERE detail_id = #{detailId} AND shipped_qty = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_srm_po_split_line (order_id, detail_id, split_qty, committed_date, status, shipped_qty, received_qty) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{detailId}, #{splitQty}, #{committedDate}, #{status}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT sl.id AS split_line_id, sl.order_id, sl.detail_id, sl.split_qty, sl.committed_date, sl.status, sl.shipped_qty, sl.received_qty, (sl.split_qty - sl.shipped_qty) AS remaining_ship_qty, d.parts_number, d.parts_name, d.need_number AS line_need_qty FROM tb_srm_po_split_line sl INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d ON d.id = sl.detail_id AND IFNULL(d.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE sl.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY sl.detail_id ASC, sl.id ASC
SELECT * FROM tb_srm_po_split_line WHERE id = #{splitLineId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_srm_po_split_line SET shipped_qty = shipped_qty + #{delta} WHERE id = #{splitLineId}
UPDATE tb_srm_po_split_line SET received_qty = received_qty + #{delta} WHERE id = #{splitLineId}
UPDATE tb_srm_po_split_line SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{splitLineId}
mapper.select: SELECT split_qty, shipped_qty, received_qty FROM tb_srm_po_split_line WHERE id = #{splitLineId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_srm_asn_line (asn_id, split_line_id, shipped_qty, received_qty, receipt_time) VALUES (#{asnId}, #{splitLineId}, #{shippedQty}, 0, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_srm_asn_line WHERE id = #{asnLineId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT al.id AS asn_line_id, al.asn_id, al.split_line_id, al.shipped_qty, al.received_qty, al.receipt_time FROM tb_srm_asn_line al WHERE al.asn_id = #{asnId} ORDER BY al.id ASC
SELECT order_id FROM tb_srm_po_split_line WHERE id = #{splitLineId}
